interactions.mechanism: Bank profitability is directly affected by yield curve slope. Steep curve improves net interest margin, flattening compresses margins.
interactions.falsification_criteria: If term spread has no differential effect on financial sector returns vs other sectors

interactions.mechanism: Utility stocks are bond proxies. Higher yields make utilities less attractive relative to bonds, reducing utility stock prices.
interactions.falsification_criteria: If yield level has no differential effect on utility sector returns

interactions.mechanism: Real estate is highly interest-rate sensitive due to leverage and duration. Higher yields increase financing costs and reduce property valuations.
interactions.falsification_criteria: If yield level has no differential effect on real estate sector returns

interactions.mechanism: Growth stocks (technology) are more sensitive to long-term discount rates. Steep curve may signal accommodative conditions favoring growth.
interactions.falsification_criteria: If term spread has no differential effect on technology sector returns

interactions.mechanism: Rising yields may signal tightening financial conditions, reducing consumer spending and discretionary purchases.
interactions.falsification_criteria: If yield changes have no differential effect on consumer discretionary returns

interactions.mechanism: Energy sector is more influenced by commodity prices than interest rates. Term spread should have weaker effect on energy vs other sectors.
interactions.falsification_criteria: If term spread has strong differential effect on energy sector (contradicts mechanism)

interactions_not_included.description: All 11 sectors x all 10 yield curve features = 110 combinations
interactions_not_included.reason: Combinatorial explosion. Must select based on economic mechanism, not exhaustive testing.
interactions_not_included.selection_principle: Only include interactions with clear, specific economic rationale
